wins.text: DARZALEX became J&J's first brand to exceed $3 billion in quarterly sales, growing 23.5% YoY with 6-point share gains in the frontline setting

SPRAVATO surpassed $1 billion in annual sales for the first time, growing 45.3% in Q4 driven by increased physician and patient demand; also received approval as first-and-only monotherapy for treatment-resistant depression
Full year 2024 free cash flow of ~$20 billion, $1.6 billion more than 2023 despite higher litigation payments and TCJA toll tax headwinds
CARVYKTI achieved $963 million in full year sales with Q4 growth of over 100% YoY and 17.3% sequential growth; 5,000th patient infused milestone reached
ERLEADA reached $3 billion in annual sales for the first time, growing 22.7% in Q4 driven by share gains and market growth

risks.text: STELARA declined 13.6% in Q4 due to biosimilar competition; U.S. biosimilars entered in January 2025 with ~$2 billion negative Part D redesign impact expected in 2025, creating a significant full-year headwind
VARIPULSE PFA catheter U.S. commercial activity temporarily paused to investigate 4 reported neurovascular events, creating near-term MedTech EP headwind while collaborating with FDA
Continued macroeconomic and VBP headwinds in China expected to persist through 2025 across MedTech segments including electrophysiology, orthopedics, and surgery
Unfavorable foreign currency impact of ~$1.7 billion (2.0%) on 2025 reported sales based on euro/USD rate of $1.04 vs. prior $1.10, reducing reported EPS by ~$0.25
Intra-Cellular Therapies acquisition expected to be dilutive to 2025 adjusted EPS by $0.30–$0.35 due to debt financing costs, with no material near-term cost synergies planned

guidance_items.detail: 2025 operational sales growth of 2.5%–3.5%, midpoint $91.3B (3.0%), in line with late-2023 enterprise business review guidance; reported sales ~$89.6B at midpoint after ~$1.7B FX headwind
2025 adjusted operational EPS of $10.75–$10.95 (8.7% growth at midpoint); reported adjusted EPS ~$10.60 after ~$0.25 FX headwind; excludes Intra-Cellular Therapies impact (~$0.30–$0.35 dilutive)

2025 adjusted pretax operating margins expected to increase ~300 bps, ~50 bps better than communicated at Q3 2024 earnings call; driven ~half by operating spend management and ~half by reduced acquired IPR&D expense

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: VARIPULSE U.S. neurovascular safety events and temporary commercial pause details (prepared remarks only noted an ongoing investigation without specifics on the 4 events)
MedTech organic growth rate below 5%–7% target range when excluding Shockwave acquisition contribution
Potential deprioritization of internal CNS pipeline assets (seltorexant, aticaprant) following Intra-Cellular Therapies acquisition
